# LobbyTeam by SophiMind

LobbyTeam helps brick-and-mortar and online businesses make sure every customer reaches an answer, a completed request, or the right human next step. It can work across phone, website chat, email, SMS, WhatsApp, and configured kiosk, tablet, or QR-code experiences.

LobbyTeam is designed to work alongside staff. It handles the requests a business defines, preserves conversation context, and routes exceptions to the right human based on availability, expertise, urgency, time zone, and ownership.

Working pricing concept:
- Starter: $49/month for 20 Interaction Units; $0.99 per additional unit.
- Essential: $99/month for 75 Interaction Units; $0.79 per additional unit.
- Full Front Door: $299/month for 500 Interaction Units; $0.59 per additional unit.
